quotes.text: AI is being used, as we all know, to detect fraud and stop seniors from getting manipulated, those especially who are targeted by scams involving deepfakes and other AI-powered tools.

Regulators have used innovation hubs and sandboxes to encourage responsible experimentation in other areas of fintech. I am personally very focused on this area.
